proposals_detail.text: Your mlops platform setup needs Kubernetes, Docker, MLflow done properly, with something you can maintain after handover. In a similar mlops project for a past client, the work cut model release time from two weeks to one day with reproducible pipelines [cs-ai_ml-mlops]. You will see a working version in the first week, so feedback shapes the rest of the work.
